assumptions: MCMC stands in for explicit cycling because ESM-2 is a starting-sequence generator.
Lysozyme PDB 2LYZ chain A is the experimental ensemble target; smoke tier truncates the segment.
BioEmu sample count is reduced on smoke tier to control GPU cost.
RMSD 4 Å and pLDDT 70 are reporting targets, not hard optimizer thresholds.
The score-only ESMFold adapter is valid here because no downstream step consumes its structure.
unknowns: Desired conformational state populations beyond a single experimental structure are not modeled.
Full 100-step / 8-sample BioEmu runs are expensive and are outside this hackathon smoke campaign.
The first portable surrogate uses amino-acid composition features and may defer most positional mutations.
